items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: Ray Lopez it looks like on cornet. On cornet, Ray, yes.

ctx.x: He's just got tons of it here. Yes. Pictures all over the place. Various bands he's played with. Well, right in front of me I can see Frisco dancing. And there's Tom in the background playing trombone and on the bass. Ray Lopez it looks like on cornet. On cornet, Ray, yes. And is that Billy Lambert?
